lines: Rockland Trust operates 151 branches, 21 commercial lending centers, 12 investment management offices, and 5 mortgage centers across Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and New Hampshire, with 1,001–5,000 employees [E-071, E-072].
Asset growth CAGR (2023–2025): ~13%, driven by Enterprise Bank acquisition. Organic growth (2023–2024) was effectively flat [E-073–E-075].

ROAA declined from 1.24% to 0.99%. The $300M subordinated debt raise in March 2025 provides acquisition funding and growth capital [E-071, E-073, E-075, E-076].
